answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 39292 Country: India Title: Please convey me whether marriage is permissible in between Ahl Hadith and Hanafi maslak Question: Please convey me whether marriage is permissible in between Ahl Hadith and Hanafi maslak? We belong to Hanafi maslak the boy belongs to Ahl Hadith. We are worried whether they are on the right path of Allah or not. Answer ID: 39292 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 349/362/N=1433) Ghair Muqallidin (who call themselves Ahl Hadith) are deviant and out of the folk of Ahl Sunnah al-Jamah as they differ from Ahl Sunnah wal Jamah not only in Furoo (derivative issues) rather in Usool (fundamentals). (For more details see Rahmatullah al-Wasiya, Vol. 2, p. 740-744) The nikah of a Hanafi girl is valid with a Ghair Muqallid boy as they are Muslims though ghair muqallidin are deviant, but due to other various reasons one should not establish marital relations with them. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
